author: Yffe
content: Fixed in 8d86189. Parenthesized the cast inner ONLY for an Expr::Binary/Unary inner across the whole class of cast-emit sites in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs + l1.rs: the Expr::Cast arm (both files), the byte_at/slice 'as usize' index coercion (both), the split 'as u8' separator coercion (both), and lower_index_arg's combinator 'as int' (lower.rs). A simple inner is left unparenthesized so the corpus/golden simple casts (i as int, acc as nat, 0 as usize) stay byte-identical. Verified against real verus 0.2026.05.24: (k-1) as nat spec fn -> L3; byte_at(i-1) in a contract -> L3 (11 obligations, no u64/usize mismatch); forge build of byte_at(i-1) -> L1 built. Added regression pin thermite-lower/tests/divergence_cast_paren.rs (4/4). Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 667 passed/0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS.
